meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按专业前端工程师的流程工作：先阅读现有代码或选好技术栈，写高质量代码，运行构建并修复所有错误，再在真实浏览器中打开并截图验证，页面在桌面和移动端都正常才宣告完成。
howto.when: 当用户提出创建、修改网站或前端应用等任务时触发；Claude 会按构建-测试-验证的完整流程执行，并强制在真实浏览器中截图确认后才算完成。

say.text: 请帮我搭建一个响应式网站，构建完记得截图验证。
say.note: Claude 会按前端流程执行，并展示浏览器截图。

say.text: 先阅读项目现有代码，再新增一个页面，最后测试和截图。
say.note: 它会先检查现有模式，再开发并验证。

say.text: 用 Vite 做一个单页应用，按你的流程走完并给出截图。
say.note: 它会选择合适工具，构建、测试、截图。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow a strict frontend engineer workflow: inspect existing code, write quality code, build and fix all errors, then visually verify the site in a real browser with screenshots before saying done.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user requests creating or modifying a website or frontend app. Claude applies the full build-test-verify sequence and requires screenshot proof before completion.

say_en.text: Please build a responsive website and verify with screenshots when done.
say_en.note: Claude shows browser screenshots after the workflow.

say_en.text: Read the existing code first, then add a page, and test with screenshots.
say_en.note: It will review patterns, build, and verify.

say_en.text: Create a Vite SPA using your full process and provide screenshots.
say_en.note: It will choose the tool, build, test, and screenshot.
